_metadata.description: Cross-verified union of the two independently-authored Waymo AV-safety ground-truth sets (GT-A from oxalpha, GT-B from claude), built by ticket GT-X. Only items that survived mechanical excerpt-fidelity checking, independent absence re-verification, answerability review, and numeric grounding audit are included. Updated 2026-08-23 (pass 2): the eleven post-merge GT-A items (Q-GTA-034..044) survived independent re-verification and joined the union.
_metadata.verification_method: Every grounding claim re-checked read-only against waymo/data/papers.db (1,738 papers / 46,155 chunks as of 2026-08-19 mtime): paper existence and title, chunk-to-paper membership, anchor_json block-id agreement, whitespace-normalized substring containment of every excerpt (primary and supporting), section-path agreement, numeral-level audit of every answer_text against the cited paper's text. All 8 absent items re-searched independently with additional adversarial probes beyond the authors' own logs. Full findings and ruled near-misses: docs/eval-reports/2026-08-22-waymo-groundtruth-cross-verification.md.
_metadata.dimension_labels_note: The two source sets use partially different dimension vocabularies (GT-A short forms e.g. 'numeric/quantitative'; GT-B noun forms e.g. 'numeric/quantitative claims'). Labels are preserved verbatim per item rather than normalized -- normalizing them here would silently rewrite the authors' labels; consumers should group via the mapping in the report if they need one bucketing.
known_caveats: Q-WAYB-027 is vision-derived: only its machine-checkable ids/page were verified; the visual claim itself is unverified by the cross-verifier.

Several GT-B absence_search logs record hit counts that do not reproduce under plain SQLite LIKE on the frozen DB (see per-item verification.notes); every qualitative absence nevertheless held up under independent re-search.
_metadata.dedup_policy: Q-GTA-036/Q-GTA-037 are independent rediscoveries of Q-WAYB-034/Q-WAYB-009; kept under their own ids with explicit duplicate_of pointers. Aggregate scoring must count each duplicate_of group once (default: exclude secondaries from denominators, report them separately).

ground_truth.question_text: What sensor payload recorded the original detection dataset, and what per-pixel feature beyond raw range helps the model tell genuine returns from weather clutter?
ground_truth.answer_text: Five LiDAR sensors and five high-resolution pinhole cameras, with data for the first two returns of each laser pulse. ground_truth.question_text: Why can't a simulation benchmark that scores agents purely on how seldom they crash distinguish a good simulator from a degenerate one, and what two properties must WOSAC submissions therefore have?
ground_truth.answer_text: Collision rate can be artificially driven to zero by static policies, so it cannot measure realism. ground_truth.question_text: Standard 3D detection scoring punishes camera-only detectors for a specific kind of mistake even when the detection is useful downstream. What mistake, what metric fix was proposed, and what surprising head-to-head result did the new metric reveal?
ground_truth.answer_text: Camera-only detectors estimate depth poorly, so reasonable detections with longitudinal (along-the-line-of-sight) localization errors fail the IoU matching of standard 3D AP and are counted as false positives. With the new metric past 10% depth-error tolerance, state-of-the-art camera-based detectors can outperform popular LiDAR-based detectors.

ground_truth.question_text: According to this corpus, what crash rate per million miles has Tesla's Full Self-Driving system achieved compared with human drivers?

Interaction mining itself (2104.10133 mines merges, lane changes, unprotected turns) is another plausible-looking distractor but is pairwise-interaction frequency, not crashes.
